nodes.text:
This is absolutely disgusting what these migrants from Pakistan have been allowed to get away with. They set up harems with hundreds of girls in different cities in England. They were subjected to mass rape. The British authorities and newspapers deliberately concealed the conflict for fear of riots. The Times refused to report it. The Guardian published a story calling those who raised the alarm racists. The most egregious incidents took place in the Manchester, Birmingham and Sheffield suburbs of Rotherham, Rochdale and Telford. There were at least 1,500 incidents in Rotherham, 1,000 in Telford and nearly 500 in Rochdale. Journalist Andrew Norfolk was the first to expose the scandal, writing that girls as young as 12 had abortions because of the abuse, and one girl of just 13 was raped more than 50 times. The father of one of the victims was arrested by the police for disorderly behaviour instead of the perpetrators. The police refused to confront the perpetrators, fearing people would protest against gangs of Pakistanis, and the crimes have been ignored. In 2020, researchers Kish Bhatti-Sinclair and Charles Sutcliffe analysed the names of defendants and found that 83% of gang rapists were Muslim. Most of the British Pakistanis were from Kashmir.
The perpetrators contrasted 'good and pure' Muslim girls in the communities with white girls, asserting that whites 'deserved to be raped'.  It's obvious these filthy animals can not nor have the desire to assimilate to Western laws and morality. To the contrary, they make every attempt to alter the decent code our values are based on and the laws. They  have successfully used false claims of Islamophobia, engaging in violent protests and rioting to put fear in government institutions thus having politicians cater to these false claims. Yet the same government will prosecute their own citizens who speak out against them. For fear of offending and losing support of the liberal and woke minded, including mainstream media, the morally weak politicians inevitably cater to and cover up the crimes of these savages, attacking those who call them out. There's no place in Western society for Muslim communities or anyone else who takes part, supports, or helps to conceal these disgusting savages. And to those who say this is a racist attitude or Islamophobia, I would ask, where are all the Muslims condemning these vile crimes? Why do Muslim groups, mosques, or imams  remain silent? The only solution to this is to hold every authority and media outlet responsible that either ignores or covers up these crimes, to imprison the actors giving some type of Justice to the victims and then send them back where they came from. In the absence of this, the only other solution is for good people to band together and protect their families & friends by whatever means needed
